about_the_game:
Experience a cinematic, story-driven FPS where destruction is your greatest weapon.
In Empty Space: The Creator, you play as Sara, a woman who wakes after a mysterious car crash, only to find herself trapped in a surreal world of her own making. As she navigates this haunting realm, she must confront the consequences of what she created… and try to escape it.

This isn't just another shooter. It's a fully destructible, emotionally charged experience built for players who crave atmosphere, intensity, and meaning.

Key Features:

  • 🎬 Cinematic Storytelling
    Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative with high quality visuals and music, combining rich atmosphere and sci-fi in a way only bold indie games dare to explore.

  • 🧱 Total Environment Destruction
    Nearly every object, wall, and building can be blown apart. Use destruction creatively in combat. but beware: debris can harm you too.

  • ⚔️ Epic Boss Battles
    Each boss fight is dynamic, unforgettable, and evolves the environment as you play. No reused ideas, no filler, just handcrafted moments that keep you on edge.

  • 🎮 A Love Letter to Single Player Games
    Forget bloated open worlds with nothing to do. Empty Space: The Creator focuses on tight design, meaningful content, and pure player immersion.

    If you’ve been missing the golden era of single-player shooters, this is for you.

    Get ready to explore. Destroy. Survive. And uncover the truth behind Sara’s digital prison.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: No VR Support
  • Additional Notes: SSD required to run the game smoothly
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision .789 or higher.
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: No VR Support
  • Additional Notes: SSD required to run the game smoothly

short_description: A cinematic first-person shooter with full environment destruction. Trapped in a surreal world of her own making, Sara must face the consequences of her past. Uncover the truth, survive dynamic boss fights, and experience a story driven journey like no other.
